summary: Explains why an OSPF Area Border Router needs a working connection to the backbone area if it is to route traffic to other areas and to outside destinations. Traffic for other areas is dropped otherwise. It then describes alternative ABR behaviors implemented in Cisco and IBM routers. It is informational and documents implementation practice.

eli5.summary: A big city is split into neighborhoods, and a few roads connect them to the main highway. This memo explains that a connecting road must really reach the highway, or cars cannot get anywhere else, and it lists other ways to build one.

questions: ospf area border router without backbone connection
